gloss: fly swiftly, dart through the air
definition: [ דָּאָה ] verb fly swiftly, dart through the air (compare perhaps Arabic run vehemently (of camel)) — Qal Imperfect יִדְאֶה Deut 28:49 + 2 t.; וַיֵּ֫דֶא Ps 18:11 (> || 2Sam 22:11 וַיֵּרָא ); fly swiftly, dart , of eagle Deut 28:49 , in simile of swift army; of Chaldaeans camp. with eagle, in judgment against Moab & Edom Jer 48:40 ; Jer 49:22 (in both || פרשׂ כנפיו ); of ׳ י in theoph. Ps 18:11 (compare 2Sam 22:11 ) וַיֵּדֶא עלכֿנפי רוח (|| וַיִּרְכַּב עַלכְּֿרוּב וַיָּעֹף ).
